title: blueprint-v2 recorded answer
description: The executor's one recorded answer of a blueprint-v2 run (references/blueprint-v2-contract.md section 7), checked by `record-answer`: this schema first (exit 4), then the shared refusals of station_core/answer.py with the trace kinds `ledger`, `repo_path`, `question` and `owner_words` (exit 5), then blueprint's own content checks (exit 5). Closed at every level. A trace is optional here so an untraced line reaches the content check and is refused by rule, and every one of the five shared trace kinds is spelled here so `assumed` is refused by the content check as a kind this core does not allow (assumptions have their own field); an `owner_words` trace carries the owner's words quoted verbatim, never blank. A criterion's `verify` is optional here for the same reason as the trace: a missing one, or one that is none of the three forms, is refused by rule. When `ceremony.needs_build_doc` is true the answer names its feature, title and intent and holds at least one constraint line.

answer_version.description: the version of this answer shape

run_id.description: the run's own id; record-answer refuses another

session_id.description: the executor's session, the adapter's answer_fields.session_id; record-answer refuses one other than the input's invocation.session_id

feature.description: the feature's slug: the build hunt's --name, and the <feature> of docs/plans/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<feature>.md

title.description: the <Feature> of the title line '# <Feature> — build plan (<date>)'

questions.description: every question put to the owner in this run

lines.description: the build doc's requirements, constraints and out-of-scope lines, each with its trace

criteria.description: the acceptance criteria, each with its verify form

slices.description: the slices this run adds or revises, in dependency order

assumptions.description: small reversible gaps the executor decided, one line each

open_questions.description: load-bearing questions the owner still owes, one line each

needs_build_doc.description: false: this does not need a build doc, and the run stops no-build-doc with no file

collapsed_gate.description: present only when the owner's invocation collapsed the gate; his words verbatim. The core records it and never acts on it

oneLine.description: one line of text, not blank

text.description: a blank text is refused by the shared check (shape)

touches.description: the ledger line ids this question touches

answer.description: the owner's answer; blank means unanswered, and an unanswered question settles nothing

kind.description: blueprint-v2 allows ledger, repo_path, question and owner_words; assumed is refused by record-answer

ref.description: the ledger line id, the workspace path, the question id, or the owner's words quoted verbatim (owner_words: not blank)

id.description: the handle a slice names; required in practice for every requirement line of a build doc

row.description: the id of the ledger row this line decides, settles, passes forward or moves (the row's id is the trace: the line is judged by it and its words are never matched against that row). Absent on a NEW line, one that names no existing row. A line whose trace is `ledger` names its row by that trace; `row` may repeat it and may not differ from it.

verify.description: one of the template's three forms: existing test | new test at <path> | manual: <steps>; missing, blank or any other text is refused by record-answer (criterion-without-verify)
